definition.title: Plan the site's page tree and redirects
definition.description: Plan the site's page tree, URL and navigation rules from live data: the latest organic audit's summary (click depth, inbound links and checks for each page it crawled), a year of Search Console clicks, the traffic snapshot's visits and Page decisions. One model call names and groups the sections; code computes the rest. When URLs must change, it lists the exact redirects for website.change, which asks you about each one before it changes the site. Follow-ups after a change compare clicks with the saved baseline. It does not read the repository: click depth and possible orphans come from the pages the audit read. Plans only; changes nothing itself.

prerequisites.reason: The audit's summary (reports/organic-audit/LATEST.json, from policy v12) supplies click depth, inbound links, possible orphans, pages that compete for one search and the sitemap size.
Page decisions name the merges and retirements the tree has to absorb.
The snapshot's visits per landing page keep a page with visits but no search clicks from being moved without a redirect.
